assertions: The fixed official Apple Search API returns a bounded US iPhone app page without an account, cookie or credential.
The result contains the expected public App Store app identity while making no claim about ranking, corpus size or historical completeness.
Only minimized app identity, developer, genre, version, price, rating summary and canonical store links are retained; descriptions, release notes, artwork and raw payloads are excluded.
The Connector makes one serialized request, respects the documented approximate 20-call-per-minute limit and never retries a failure.
The live result matches the public product schema and exposes no hidden Connector route, request endpoint, credential or internal trace.
